name: Lenomila Shelf
releaseNotes: Adds a persisted language selector with phone-language defaults and localizes Lenomila Shelf-owned UI, dialogs, download/status messages, share text, and update notifications across English, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Arabic, Bengali, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, and Turkish. Also adds targeted package visibility for UniWhisper and WhisperScribe without broad package queries.
description: Lenomila Shelf is a companion private Android app catalog for the same signed app collection. It focuses on browsing, sharing, checking updates, viewing release details, choosing a persisted app language, and installing verified GitHub-hosted APKs through Android's normal installer flow.
